prompt.text:
Implement `createAccessRegistry()` and export exactly `{ createAccessRegistry }` using CommonJS. It returns an isolated in-memory registry with methods `register(details)`, `open(email, secret)`, `inspect(token)`, and `close(token)`. `details` must be a plain object containing exactly `email`, `secret`, `givenName`, and `familyName`, all non-empty strings. Emails are compared after converting to lowercase; registering a duplicate throws `Error('Email already registered')`. `open` requires non-empty string arguments, throws `Error('Invalid credentials')` for an unknown email or wrong secret, and returns `{ token, account }`. Tokens are deterministic per registry (`session-1`, `session-2`, and so on). `inspect` returns a fresh public account object for an active token and throws `Error('Invalid session')` for malformed, unknown, or closed tokens. `close` marks an active session closed and returns `true`; malformed, unknown, or already-closed tokens return `false`. Public account objects contain only `email`, `givenName`, and `familyName`; normalized lowercase email is returned. The registry must not retain `details` or expose mutable internal objects.
